title: Enhancing defence cooperation and maritime security in Southeast Asia
summary: Australia is strengthening defence cooperation and maritime security in Southeast Asia to enhance the stability and prosperity of our region.Following a visit to HMAS Stalwart in Manila today, Prime Minister Albanese witnessed the signing of a new Australia–Philippines Defence Cooperation Arrangement.

title: Jollibee coming to Australia

title: Press conference - Manila, Philippines
summary: COMMANDER ASHLEIGH PAYNE, CSC, RAN, COMMANDING OFFICER HMAS STALWART: Ladies and gentlemen, good morning. I'm Commander Ashleigh Payne, Commanding Officer of HMAS Stalwart, and it's our privilege to host you here today. I'd now like to introduce the Honourable Anthony Albanese MP, Prime Minister of Australia.
